# HERMES Agents Forge — Skill Pack

This is a HERMES skill pack for team-based agent workflows.

## Installation

1. Install HERMES Agent: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/getting-started/installation
2. Clone this repo and run: `hermes skills opt-in --sync`
3. Use `/forge` to start team design workflow

## Documentation

- HERMES.md: Overview of our agent system
- skills/forge/SKILL.md: Forge skill for team provisioning
- PRODUCT.md: Product goals and user flow

## Official HERMES Docs

https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs
